text: Foundation Model Security
For the Enterprise  ·  Sanchit Alekh  ·  Google Cloud  ·  August 2026
Three shifts made this a board-level issue.
Frontier labs now gate cyber and biological uplift as explicit capability thresholds.
EU AI Act GPAI duties apply from August 2025; systemic-risk fines follow in 2026.
MCP tool poisoning and indirect injection reached real CVEs in 2025.
OWASP, NIST AI RMF and ISO 42001 now give auditors a concrete yardstick.
The threat surface has three layers
RAND catalogues 38 attack vectors across five security levels, SL1 to SL5.
Instructions and data share one channel, so content can redirect the model.
Tool access turns a content compromise into an action under the agent's identity.
All three frontier labs refreshed their frameworks in 2025 — and they converge.
Responsible Scaling Policy. ASL tiers bind controls to capability; Opus 4 shipped under ASL-3.
Preparedness Framework v2. Tracked categories gated on High and Critical thresholds.
Frontier Safety Framework v3. Critical Capability Levels now include misalignment.
Evaluate, set a threshold, pre-commit to mitigations, re-evaluate as capability grows.
Indirect prompt injection has no complete defence today.
Containment over prevention. Design for blast radius, not detection rate.
Tier the controls, not the policy.
Mapping controls to Google Cloud
Model Armor screens prompts and responses. Security Command Center AI Protection finds shadow AI. VPC Service Controls and CMEK contain blast radius.
From perpetual pilot to governed production.
